decisions.reason: The supplement range is a core part of the firm's established consumer health offer, and there is no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, so an expanding firm with slack has no trigger for problemistic search.

The skin and hair supplement sits close to the core pharmacy business at low incremental cost, and with no reported underperformance it stays in the portfolio, although the website no longer shows it.
As an extension of the established Trivital brand, the joint supplement uses existing channels and brand equity, so a withdrawal would bring little resource gain while no shortfall is evident.

The OTC triptan is distant from the core offer and its results are still uncertain without website evidence, but it matches the stated move into consumer health medicines, and the slack of an expanding firm lets management give it more time rather than drop it early.
